subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world fraction word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out a simple sharing scenario with on-screen objects
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a bar model to represent a one-step word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step fraction word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot translate word problem language into a fraction model

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile (e.g. sports stats, favorite animals)
